content: tuya-device-sharing-sdk (device-sharing/QR flow) uses MQTT over WebSocket for real-time push, NOT Pulsar. Pulsar is the developer-project/IoT-Core path. SDK class SharingMQ (start/stop/add_message_listener) + Manager.refresh_mq + SharingDeviceListener (update_status / updated_status_properties). v0.2.0 added MQTT bulk subscription. HA tuya IoT class = Cloud Push. No official Node SDK; must port MQTT-over-WS to TS.
